query: Micron HBM revenue most recent quarter

output.content:
Micron did **not disclose a dollar amount for HBM revenue** in its most recent reported quarter, fiscal Q4 2026 (ended September 3, 2026). [[1]] [[2]] 

It disclosed that HBM revenue grew **faster than total company revenue** in FQ4, while total revenue was **$54.23 billion**; therefore, an HBM-revenue figure cannot be derived from the release or earnings deck. [[2]]

sources.title: Micron Technology, Inc. - Micron Technology, Inc. Reports Record Fiscal Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2026 Results
